value: Callers need to reserve space for escaped regular-expression text without allocating a temporary string. Add documented public escape_len(pattern: &str) -> usize APIs to the regex and regex-syntax crates. Return the escaped UTF-8 byte length without allocating. Make escaping a nonempty pattern use at most one allocation and empty input none. Preserve escaping results, append behavior, existing APIs and builds without default features. Discover the implementation and integration points from the workspace.
